test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'entails'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Entails" **is the most appropriate word to** fill in blank number 1 **as it conveys the** meaning of involving something as a necessary part or consequence.**
 
• In the context of the passage, **being constant involves (or entails) repeating a task or action, or performing an activity without a stop or interval as a necessary part of the process.**
 
• The word 'entails' fits seamlessly into the sentence, suggesting that consistency requires ongoing effort and dedication.
 
• It implies that for** one to achieve consistency, they must accept and incorporate the continuous effort that comes **with it.
 
• Using 'entails' enriches the sentence by emphasizing that consistency is not just about the actions taken but also about understanding and embracing the commitment they demand.
 
• Therefore, 'entails' accurately captures the essence of what being constant in an activity demands from an individual.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of all the options: 
 
• 
 
 
• **Initiates** - प्रारंभ करना (to start)
 
• **Envelops** - ढकना, आच्छादित करना (to cover, to surround)
 
• **Figure** - आकृति, आंकड़े निकालना (shape, to calculate)
 
• **Entails** - एक आवश्यक या अपरिहार्य भाग या परिणाम के रूप में (कुछ) शामिल करना (involve (something) as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence.)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *Being constant **(1)** __**entails**__ repeating a task or action, or performing an activity without a stop or interval. Consistency can never be attained in a sporadic or (2) _______ manner. When you perform anything regularly or constantly, you will not only build expertise in that area, but you will also gain a better (3) _______ of it. Because of the greater amount of effort put in over a longer period of time, this enhanced comprehension is (4) _______. As a result, consistency is the (5) _______ that allows anyone to consistently put in the effort.*

1a0:Tb86,

The correct answer is '**intermittent**'.
